summary: The MG card file had 10 ended historic families marked productionStatus unknown, Metro with no years and Magnette Mk IV with an open end; fixed with sources, and 9 placeholder summaries replaced with factual Czech text. Proposed make foundedYear 1924, 350 start year 2010, removal of the MG E50 (a Roewe) and a duplicate S5 row.
